Chinese Farm Economy 1930

A Study of 2866 Farms in Seventeen Localities and Seven Provinces in China
John Lossing Buck; University of Chicago Press, Chicago, for the University of Nanking and the China Council of the Institute of Pacific Relations, 1930

Every page was surveyed on contact sheets by Claude Sonnet, and the 295 pages with tables were read once: by GPT-6.1-Sol (low reasoning effort) where the table is printed sideways, by Gemini 3.8 Flash otherwise (two early sideways jobs by Gemini 4 Argon). The 77 sideways pages were turned upright before reading. All 252 tables are transcribed; table numbers restart in each chapter, and Chapter IV has no Table 11 (deleted in the book itself). The blank schedule forms of Appendix IV, the charts, photographs and prose are not transcribed. Unreadable figures are marked [?]; printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted.
